contract.definition: selectedStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s: Staff | s.Id = contactsid)
contract.precondition: Device.allInstances()->forAll(d: Device | d.Id <> id) and Staff.allInstances()->exists(s: Staff | s.Id = contactsid)
contract.postcondition: let newDevice: Device in newDevice.oclIsNew() and result = true and Device.allInstances()->includes(newDevice) and newDevice.Id = id and newDevice.Name = name and newDevice.Location = location and newDevice.Contacts = selectedStaff
